User: It's kind of like the Big Mac sister, it's the competitor burger. I really like the Whopper too. It's nice and fresh, it has the tomato which the Big Mac doesn't. I would say it's my second favorite fast food item.
Agent: That's a clear connection, being the competitor burger and your second favorite.

Can you name two or three other similar items you also like from any chain? And for each one, what's better or worse compared to your favorite Big Mac?
